opening.argument: The central offer is a branded Coinbase One Card promotion: purchases can earn up to 4% back in bitcoin. The reward is qualified, not unconditional. Its rate depends on the cardholder’s assets on Coinbase, not all transactions qualify as eligible purchases, and the offer is subject to terms, eligibility, and approval. Those stated limits and the card’s availability and issuer disclosures frame it as a qualified commercial promotion, not a request for credentials or a payment scheme. The record supports the advertised offer and its conditions, without establishing any particular applicant’s approval or reward outcome.

citations.quote: Coinbase One Card | Turn every purchase into bitcoin.
Earn up to 4% back in bitcoin on every purchase, plus all of the benefits included in a Coinbase One membership.
Bitcoin-back rates are based on cardholder’s assets on Coinbase.
Not all transactions are eligible purchases.
